name: Compass & Kite Journeys
tagline: Slow, tailor-made trips planned in Toronto
description: A two-person travel studio planning tailor-made trips by rail, road and ferry, for travellers who would rather see one region well than ten in a hurry.
hours_note: Office visits by appointment. Video calls available evenings.

trips.name: Portugal by rail
trips.route: Porto · Douro Valley · Coimbra · Lisbon · Alentejo

trips.name: Japan's back roads
trips.route: Kanazawa · Takayama · Kiso Valley · Kyoto · Naoshima

trips.name: Newfoundland coast
trips.route: St. John's · Bonavista · Twillingate · Gros Morne

process.title: A conversation
process.text: A 30-minute call about where you want to go, how you like to travel, and your budget.

process.title: A draft route
process.text: Within a week we send a day-by-day draft with places to stay and how you'll get between them.

process.title: Booked and handed over
process.text: Once you're happy, we book it and send a printed travel book and a 24/7 number for the trip.

facts.pricing: Prices on request. Every trip is costed to your dates and choices.
